mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate directly reduces the risk-free rate component of equity discount rates, leading to higher present values of future cash flows and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return direction is not positively correlated with FEDFUNDS level (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% within a 1-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces corporate profit expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) within the same month signals a contraction in consumer and business demand, which reduces near-term corporate revenue growth expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained industrial production index above 100.5 signals robust supply conditions that may lead to inflationary pressures, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO > 100.5.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading above 3.0% indicates persistent inflation, which delays expected monetary policy easing and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A higher quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) signals stronger economic activity and corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return direction is not positively correlated with GDPC1 growth (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A non-farm payrolls level below 120,000 (thousands) signals a severely weakened labor market, reducing consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS < 120000.

mechanism_narrative: A higher CPI index level (CPIAUCSL) reflects persistent inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward return direction is not negatively correlated with CPIAUCSL level (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
